name: Katakura Yuuno
source:
An extreeemely pushy and overprotective girl who is in her first year of nursing school. Satsuki’s classmate and dormmate. Has a soft, feminine disposition.  Fairly protective, she always speaks formally, with a deference to others.
 
Her overbearing disposition stems from her “What would you do without me?” attitude toward the frequently troubled Satsuki.

[[url=http://petalsgarden.axypb.net/2013/07/11/yurin-yurin-official-website-5/]Translated[/url] from [url=http://www.yurinyurin.com/tensitatinoharukoi/character.html]Yurin Yurin[/url]]
